service-operator/runbooks/KEY_ROTATION.title: Key Rotation Overview
service-operator/runbooks/KEY_ROTATION.description: This document is the entry point for all AI Factory key rotation procedures. It describes which key types exist, their rotation schedule, and which rotations require downtime. The runbooks for those procedures are linked below.

service-operator/runbooks/key-rotation/S.title: Rotate SSH Keys
service-operator/runbooks/key-rotation/S.description: This runbook rotates the Ed25519 key pair used to access all infrastructure hosts (bare-metal nodes, management cluster VMs, Hedgehog fabric). Rotation uses a zero-downtime approach: the new key is added to all hosts before the old key is removed.

service-operator/runbooks/key-rotation/V.title: Rotate WireGuard VPN Keys
service-operator/runbooks/key-rotation/V.description: This runbook rotates the WireGuard private key for a tenant VPN server. Rotation is zero-touch on the server side: update the Barbican secret and the server picks it up automatically within 60 seconds — no SSH access, no restart, no signal required.
